text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, even though the sun over here
is shining so bright and dazzling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While heading to the training room,
I saw an infuriated El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
Please listen to thisss, deee~su!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"My lap times got faster, so
I wanted Papa to praise me, yes!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And yet, because of the time difference,
Daddy was already fast asleep, YES!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, darn you, jet laaaaag...!
One of these days, I swear I'm gonna give you
a German supleeeeex!!
